# Dichroic (`dichroic`)

Dichroic glass panes turn slowly in a sunlit gallery, throwing colour across the floor and wall.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: sun, location
- Cost: medium (~5.4 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Dichroic, Black Box

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `panes` | Panes | slider | 1 … 5 (step 1) | 3 |
| `speed` | Turn Speed | slider | 0 … 2 (step 0.25) | 1 |
| `glass` | Glass | menu | 0 Mixed · 1 Magenta/Green · 2 Cyan/Gold · 3 Blue/Amber | 0 (Mixed) |
| `shape` | Shapes | menu | 0 Mixed · 1 Rectangles · 2 Discs · 3 Arches | 0 (Mixed) |
| `sun` | Sun Height | slider | 10 … 70 | 27 |
| `dir` | Sun Direction | slider | -60 … 60 | -55 |
| `live` | Follow the Sun | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `room` | Room | menu | 0 Gallery White · 1 Warm Concrete · 2 Black Box | 0 (Gallery White) |
